setupCommands: cd go-style-engine && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt
serviceNotes: No external services. CPU-only by design (see go-style-engine/README.md).

requirements.txt pins numpy==2.5.2/torch==2.13.0, which need Python 3.12+. On a host with only 3.11 (e.g. Debian 12's default repos), install unpinned-but-compatible versions instead: .venv/bin/pip install -q numpy torch pytest.
